feeds.title: Psychology of Music
feeds.description: Psychology of Music publishes peer reviewed papers directed at increasing the scientific understanding of any psychological aspect of music. These include studies on listening, performing, creating, memorising, analysing, describing, learning, and teaching, as well as applied social, developmental, attitudinal and therapeutic studies.

feeds.title: Neuroscience News » Music
feeds.description: Neuroscience News research articles cover neurology, psychology, AI, brain science, mental health, robotics and cognitive sciences in a free, open access magazine. Neuroscience News publishes science research news about neuroscience, psychology, mental health, AI, neurology, brains, robotics, neurotech and more.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Music News
feeds.description: Read about the latest research on the benefits of musical training, the psychology of music and the therapeutic value of listening to music. ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations.

feeds.title: Bulletproof Musician Blog
feeds.description: Noa Kageyama started this blog so that he could put into writing, some of the things he has learned over the years from both his musical background and his psychology training.

feeds.title: Music & Science Lab Blog
feeds.description: Find Information, Research on music cognition and music psychology at The Music & Science Lab (MSL) at Durham University. MSL is an interdisciplinary undertaking where people from different disciplines are brought together by interests in the processes that underlie musical activities and empirical approaches to study them.

feeds.title: Music Psychology
feeds.description: Articles on Music Psychology by Dr Victoria Williamson. Dr. Victoria Williamson is an independent authority, scholar and consultant on the psychology of music; how music is processed by the brain and the ways music impacts our minds and behaviours.

feeds.title: Music, Mind & Brain @ Goldsmiths University Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts, photos, news and research on Music Psychology and the Brain. We are students and related folk (i.e interns) on the MSc in Music, Mind, and Brain at Goldsmiths, University of London, a programme that focuses on the cognitive and biological foundations of musical behaviour.
